Minimum service tier listed JPY 9900 per month, with different maintenance and repair coverage across tiers
limitations: Price proves an offer exists, not mass-market demand, market size or attainable startup conversion. Region and plan conditions apply.

title: Muse Help Center — Comparing Muse Experiences
claims: Muse app translates real-time brain and body signals from headband sensors into sound feedback
EEG Mind feedback and fNIRS Strength feedback are distinct experiences; compatibility varies
limitations: InteraXon Muse is a headband brand, distinct from Meta Muse. Vendor calm/active labels do not independently validate emotional-state inference. Device support and SDK availability need model-level checking.

title: Consumer-Grade Neurofeedback With Mindfulness Meditation: Meta-Analysis
claims: 16 training randomized controlled trials involved 763 unique participants, with 5 additional within-participant designs
Small psychological-distress effect g=-0.16; no detected advantage for cognition, mindfulness or physiological health
No included consumer-grade trial used sham neurofeedback and target brain-modulation mechanism was not established
Dry electrode signal can be affected by muscle activity; spectral signals do not straightforwardly map to psychological processes
limitations: Small samples, intervention heterogeneity and short study duration constrain certainty. Abstract/body differ on the additional within-participant total, so that count is not quoted.

title: AI Companions Reduce Loneliness
claims: Authors report a one-week longitudinal study with reductions in loneliness
Feeling heard is explored as an explanation of companion benefits
limitations: This read used the original author abstract, not independent reanalysis. Short-term results do not establish long-term safety, clinical efficacy, hardware or EEG superiority, retention or willingness to pay.

title: ElliQ official FAQs
claims: Designed for people 60 and older who live alone or spend most of their day alone
Proactive companionship, wellness routines and caregiver connection
Membership bundles leased device, software, support, updates and warranty; active membership is required
limitations: Page includes stale generic store fragments; rely on the specific FAQ body, not unpopulated price widgets. Vendor benefit language is not independent outcome evidence.

title: Omi official product overview
claims: Wearable audio capture, conversation memory, summaries, tasks and application connections
Official page states open-source and local-running options
limitations: User counts, integration counts, accuracy and security statements are vendor claims not independently audited here; full feature parity and licensing require repository-level verification. Audio capture is not brain sensing.

title: Plaud Note Pro official product page
claims: One-press recording for in-person conversations and phone calls
AI transcription, summaries and professional/custom templates

limitations: Manufacturer claims about convenience, range and accuracy are not independent comparative tests. Existing meeting summarization does not by itself establish unmet task-resumption demand.
